description: Steward-side remediation status for webspace index findings. A status recorded here is a claim by the steward, not evidence. A finding is only marked verified when a machine index generated after the report date shows the fix. Nothing in this file clears a finding by itself.

statuses.confirmed_open: Steward confirmed the finding is correct; remediation not yet reported.
statuses.steward_reported_fixed: Steward reports the fix was made; awaiting a newer machine index to verify.

entries.statement: Steward confirmed the finding and reports that PsiCat's GitHub write access has been removed.
Steward confirmed the finding. Each listed function still needs reading before it is called a hole; see the privilege-expansion review for the reading order.
Steward confirmed the finding. The .npmrc inside the stale public bundle must be opened; any token in it must be rotated, and the stale bundle should be withdrawn.

verification.also_requires: rotation_confirmed: a steward statement that the file was inspected and any token in it rotated (an index cannot show this)

entries.statement: PSICAT_GITHUB_TOKEN is used by no function. With GitHub write access removed, it should be deleted rather than kept as an unused credential.
